blocks.text: Machine learning mechanisms (seekhne ke tareeqe) batate hain ke system data se kaise seekhta hai. Mukhtalif masloon ke liye mukhtalif tareeqe istemal hote hain. Kuch tareeqe labeled data istemal karte hain aur kuch nahi (Figure 6.4).

blocks.title: Labeled aur unlabeled data
blocks.text: Labeled data mein har cheez ke saath us ka sahi jawab (label) likha hota hai, jaise seb ki tasveer ke saath "Apple". Unlabeled data mein sirf cheezein hoti hain, jawab nahi; system ko khud groups dhoondne parte hain.

blocks.alt: Do tables saath saath. Baen taraf LABELED DATA (label wala data): columns Image aur Label, rows seb - Apple, kela - Banana, malta - Orange, angoor - Grapes; neeche: 'Used in supervised learning (e.g., classification, regression)'. Daen taraf UNLABELED DATA (baghair label ka data): 4 x 3 khanon mein yehi phal mili juli tarteeb se, koi label nahi; neeche: 'Used in unsupervised learning (e.g., clustering, association)'.

blocks.long_description: Baen taraf har tasveer ke saath us ka naam (label) likha hai; daen taraf tasveeron ke naam nahi diye gaye.

blocks.text: Kuch tareeqe feedback aur tajurbe se seekhte hain. Har mechanism ka seekhne ka apna tareeqa hai. Sahi mechanism chunna aham hai, kyunke seekhne ki quality isi par munhasir hai. Yeh mechanisms zaheen faisle karne mein madad dete hain, aur machine learning systems theek mechanism ke baghair achha kaam nahi karte. Neeche machine learning ki kuch qismein hain:

Supervised machine learning training ke liye labeled data istemal karti hai. Har data item ka ek input aur ek sahi output hota hai. System apna output sahi jawab se mila kar seekhta hai, jaise ustad ki nigrani (supervision) mein. Is ke liye bare labeled datasets chahiye, jaise emails jin par "spam" ya "not spam" likha ho, tasaveer jin par "cat" ya "dog" likha ho, ya medical scans jin par "normal" ya "abnormal" likha ho. Zyada aur achhi quality ki misalon par train karne se is ki accuracy aam taur par barhti hai. Asal applications mein is ka bohat istemal hai: face recognition (chehre ki pehchan), bimari ki pehchan, speech recognition (awaz pehchanna), fraud detection (dhoka pakarna) aur recommendation systems (pasand ki cheezein tajweez karna). Yeh tareeqa prediction (andaza lagane) ke kaamon mein istemal hota hai, maslan email spam pakarna aur imtihan ke result ka andaza.

Unsupervised machine learning unlabeled data ke saath kaam karti hai. System baghair rehnumai ke khud patterns dhoondta hai. Yeh milte julte data ko ikattha kar ke clusters (groups) banata hai. Yeh chhupi hui structures (banawat) dhoondne mein mufeed hai. Koi sahi output nahi diya jata; seekhna is par munhasir hai ke data aapas mein kitna milta hai. Unsupervised learning data ka rawaiya samajhne aur data ko explore (khoj) karne mein madad deti hai. Misal: customers ki grouping aur data clustering.

Reinforcement machine learning tajurbe se seekhti hai, bilkul insaan ki tarah. System ek environment (mahol) ke saath kaam karta hai, aur har action (amal) par use reward (inaam) ya penalty (saza) milti hai. Achhe inaam sahi rawaiye ko barhawa dete hain, aur system waqt ke saath behtar faisle karna seekh leta hai. Yeh tareeqa robotics aur games mein istemal hota hai. Seekhna trial and error (aazma kar, ghalti se seekh kar) se jaari rehta hai, aur maqsad zyada se zyada inaam hasil karna hai. Misalein: robot jo inaam aur saza se maze (bhool-bhulaiyan) ka rasta seekhta hai; AlphaGo jo Go game khel khel kar apni strategy behtar karta hai; autonomous (khud chalne wali) gaari jo driving ke faisle behtar karti hai; aur movie recommendation system jo users ke feedback se apni tajaweez badalta hai.

blocks.title: Rule-based systems
blocks.text: Exercise (Long Question 3) rule-based learning ka bhi zikr karti hai jo chapter mein bayan nahi hui. Rule-based systems logon ke likhe hue if-then rules par chalte hain, 6.3 ki traditional programming ki tarah; woh data se khud patterns nahi seekhte.

blocks.prompt: Har kaam ke liye kaun si qism? (a) Khareedari ki aadaton se customers ke groups banana jab koi category na di gayi ho. (b) Pichhli farokht (sales) se gharon ki qeemat ka andaza. (c) Jeetne par inaam de kar ek program ko game khelna sikhana.
blocks.explanation: (a) Unsupervised (clustering). (b) Supervised (pichhli qeematein labels hain; yeh regression hai). (c) Reinforcement (inaam aur saza).

items: Supervised: labeled data, prediction ke kaam.
Unsupervised: unlabeled data, clusters dhoondti hai.
Reinforcement: environment mein actions, inaam aur saza, trial and error.
